data.notes: October 2026 already has a strong confirmed mix of outdoor festivals, J-pop/rock arena and live-house dates, Latin dance events, and electronic-leaning special concerts across Tokyo.

events.title: TOKYO ISLAND 2026
events.summary: TOKYO ISLAND returns for its fifth edition over the October three-day weekend at Sea Forest Park, presented as a large outdoor music festival with attractions and tickets already announced.

events.title: Yokai Bon Odori 2026
events.summary: This three-day West Tokyo festival in Tachikawa combines live performances, music concerts, DJ performances, Bon Odori, costumes, and food stalls.

events.title: La Bachata Tokyo World Congress 2026
events.summary: A multi-day bachata congress and Latin dance festival in Shibuya, with pre-parties from October 14 and the main event from October 16 to 18; confirmed artists include Eduard & Maria, Danny & Dayana, Meline & Rain, Anastasia & Jovanny, and Phong & Zoey.

events.title: The Caribbean / Latin America Street 2026
events.summary: A free, rain-or-shine Caribbean and Latin America cultural festival at Yoyogi Park Keyaki Street, highlighting music, dance, food, drink, and fashion from the region.

events.title: THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES presents FRONT CHAPTER DECADE Tour 2026 Final
events.summary: THE SPELLBOUND and BOOM BOOM SATELLITES present the tour final for Michiyuki Kawashima’s 10th memorial live, with the Tokyo date confirmed at SGC HALL ARIAKE.

events.title: Fumiya Fujii ARENA LIVE 2026 360°
events.summary: Fumiya Fujii brings his 360-degree arena production to Nippon Budokan for two Tokyo shows, backed by a full live band including Naoyuki Fujii on sax and guitar.

events.title: CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso: Free Spirits World Tour
events.summary: Argentinian duo CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso play their first headline show in Japan in Tokyo, with the Toyosu PIT date confirmed for October 22.

events.title: ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION Tour 2026 “Midage Fanclub”
events.summary: ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION mark the 20th anniversary of their album “Fanclub” with two confirmed Tokyo dates at Zepp DiverCity.

events.title: BUMP OF CHICKEN TOUR 2026-2027 Ratio Clavis
events.summary: BUMP OF CHICKEN’s Ratio Clavis arena tour includes two confirmed Tokyo performances at Ariake Arena on October 27 and 28.

events.title: ReoNa Concert Tour 2026 “De:TOUR -静脈-”
events.summary: ReoNa’s 2026 concert tour stops at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA for a Tokyo show with doors at 17:30 and start at 18:30.
